cues.text: Endless sand dunes stretch to the horizon, bathed in the golden light of a low sun.
A massive reddish moon dominates the hazy sky. Dark winged creatures glide on the desert thermals.
A bright streak plunges from the upper atmosphere. A landing craft trails white light as it descends toward the silent wastes.

beats.note: Fade in on a vast desert landscape with rolling sand dunes. The sun is low on the horizon, casting a warm golden glow. A large reddish moon hangs in the sky.
Dark, winged creatures fly across the hazy sky.
A bright streak enters the frame from the top left, descending rapidly.
The landing craft leaves a long white trail as it heads towards the horizon.
